items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Well, I played a few jobs with Pete.

ctx.x: But that was just a little neighborhood, uh... Yeah. We used to play for ourselves, you know, our own entertainment. But they got a few jobs out of town, but my mother wouldn't let me go.
Well, I played a few jobs with Pete.
Well, I had stopped playing with him.
